items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I have done so many recordings with Nancy Wilson, you know, I've just -- I was on her television show.

ctx.x: Just a quartet, just a quartet. Yeah, you know. And Nancy. So we played and Nancy sat down, and it was very informal and she just sang and we played for about an hour, and that was it.
Do you have many gigs like that?
